responsibility: Defines the main target description macros for MN10300, covering preprocessor builtins, default ABI and linker/startfile specs, endian and data-layout properties, register numbering and names, fixed/call-used register sets, calling-convention constants, PIC conventions, condition-code integration, assembler syntax, debugging defaults, and numerous target macros that connect generic GCC code to MN10300-specific helpers. It is the central architectural configuration header consumed across the backend.
same_name_distinction: The architectural target header for MN10300: unlike mn10300.cc it declares macros, constants, register/layout conventions, and hook-facing interfaces rather than implementing the logic; unlike mn10300.md it is not the generated RTL machine-description source of insn patterns and scheduling attributes; and unlike mn10300.opt it does not declare user-visible -m switches. In this same-name group it is the central preprocessor/macro configuration header consumed by the rest of the backend.
